title: Do not fall for a free trial or you won’t get your money back
body: Saw the app from an ad and paid 1$ for 3 days free trial. Which was ok but after exploring, the content is far from being worth 39.90 usd a month and they will not refund you even if you request for cancellation within the same date free trial is expiring. Such inflexibility is ridiculous for an app targeting a group of users who are struggling mentally. It seems like they just wanna keep making 39.90$ this way
author: KannikaY

title: Useless app. Can’t help anything
body: The subscription of 29USD a month is a rip off comparing to what the app did.
author: MonMil

title: Ok so far
body:
Please make the journals simpler or an option to just journal instead of clicking through. 

It would be great to say log the 3 good things about the day right in the journal but it doesn’t feel like there’s a good space for that. I have to exit the app to write these things down and it interrupts flow.
author: Gbarr211
